::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions"}
#docs
Cursor-paginated. `?customer=cus_a` scopes to one customer; `?customer=cus_a,cus_b` to a set. That shorthand is described here rather than listed as a parameter because it shares its name with the `customer` filter below, and a parameter name may only be declared once; `?customer[is]=cus_a` works too.

The business's own CUSTOM FIELDS filter through the same grammar but cannot be listed below: they are defined per business, so `?cf_<api_name>[<op>]=<value>` (e.g. `?cf_plan_tier[is]=gold`) is resolved per request from that business's definitions. Read them from `GET /v1/businesses/{biz}/custom_fields`.

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The subscription's id (sub_…). |
| `data.status` | `string` | The subscription's status. One of `future`, `in_trial`, `active`, `non_renewing`, `paused`, `cancelled`. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The subscription's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `data.current_period_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | The current billing term end. NULL while `in_trial` — a trial is not a term, so a trialling subscription reports `trial_end` instead and this is null (one or the other is reported, never both). Use `next_billing_at` for "when is this customer charged again?", which answers across every status. |
| `data.next_billing_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the next invoice will be raised: trial end while in_trial, the scheduled start while future, the first renewal not skipped while active (or the next monthly usage invoice, when it is earlier); null once non_renewing/paused/cancelled, where no further invoice is due |
| `data.bill_usage_monthly` | `boolean` | Metered usage is invoiced every month inside the billing period. |
| `data.current_sub_period_start` | `string · ISO-8601` | Monthly usage billing: usage before this instant is billed. Null when monthly usage billing is off. |
| `data.current_sub_period_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | Monthly usage billing: when the next monthly usage invoice is raised. Null when off. |
| `data.commitment` | `object` | Minimum commitment for one full billing period, or null. See GET /subscriptions/{id}/commitment for the counted fees. |
| `data.skipped_renewals` | `array of string · ISO-8601` | Upcoming renewals scheduled to be skipped, as the instants the clock renews at. See `skip_renewal`. |
| `data.recurring_amount_minor` | `integer` | What one billing period charges for the recurring items, in minor units, net of discounts that last more than one period and before tax; null when cancelled or when an item recurs on a different cadence than the subscription |
| `data.revenue_to_date_minor` | `integer` | DERIVED, read-only: cash collected on this subscription's invoices, in its currency — succeeded payments minus succeeded refunds. Credits applied to invoices are excluded. Emitted by GET (detail) only. |
| `data.revenue_paid_invoices_count` | `integer` | How many of this subscription's invoices received a succeeded payment. |
| `data.revenue_since` | `string · ISO-8601` | The first succeeded payment on this subscription; null when nothing was collected. |
| `data.custom_fields` | `object` | Stored custom-field values; also flattened onto the object as cf_&lt;name&gt; |
| `data.shipping_address_id` | `string` | The shipping address this subscription is set to ship to; null when it ships to the customer's default. Emitted by GET (detail), create, and an update that sends it. |
| `data.shipping_address` | `object` | Where this subscription ships now: its own address, else the customer's default, else null. Invoices record a copy when they are issued. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Opaque; pass as starting_after |
| `next_offset` | `string` | Present only while has_more; the same opaque token as next_cursor — pass as offset |
| `total` | `integer` | Filtered-set count; first page only |
